facts.text: I wanted to tell you over dinner for years. Tea first, the truth can wait.
facts.why: Not found among Shu Lien's lines on the quote pages. A real line about feelings left unsaid is 'To repress one's feelings only makes them stronger.' This one is printed in quote marks.
facts.fix: To repress one's feelings only makes them stronger.

fix_note.text: To repress one's feelings only makes them stronger.

facts.text: For the Invincible Sword Goddess. Mind the furniture.
facts.why: I could not open a source that gives Jen the title 'Invincible Sword Goddess'. She is the Hidden Dragon of the title, and she wrecks a teahouse with the Green Destiny, so the furniture part works.
facts.fix: For Jen, the Hidden Dragon. Mind the furniture.
